name: twitch-chat-bot
description: Twitch Chat Bot built with TMI.js

scripts.registry:smoke: node -e "const { getCommand, listCommands } = require('./command-registry/commandRegistry'); for (const name of ['hello','HELLO','stuck','birb','today','weather']) { const entry = getCommand(name); if (!entry) throw new Error(name + ' missing'); console.log(name + ':' + entry.type + ':obs=' + entry.requiresObs); } console.log('registered=' + listCommands().length)"
scripts.test: npm run check --silent && npm run registry:smoke --silent

author: Marcus McBride
